text.p: Privately held Protein Sciences Corp and Sequus Pharmaceutical Inc said on Tuesday they have agreed to develop a commercial scale manufacturing process to produce Sequus's liposome incorporated CD4 protein to treat HIV/AIDS.
Sequus will use one of Protein Sciences's processes to produce the protein, the companies said in a joint statement.
Under the agreement, SEQUUS made an equity investment in Protein Sciences, is funding research and development expenses and will purchase product for clinical trials, the companies said.
Following licensure, Protein Sciences will manufacture all of SEQUUS' requirements for commercial grade CD4 and receive royalties on product sales, the companies said.
Sequus shares traded at 13-3/4, up 1-1/2, on 289,800 shares of volume.
Earlier today, Sequus reported fourth quarter revenues of $11.4 million and a loss of $5.6 million. In last year's fourth quarter, Sequus reported revenues of $852,000 and a loss of $9.7 million.
